title: US State Privacy Laws Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to exercise your privacy rights under state laws like Texas, Virginia, Colorado. Easy-to-use letter for data access, deletion, and opt-out.
description: A comprehensive template letter to help you exercise your privacy rights under various US state privacy laws including Texas, Virginia, Colorado, and other states with data protection legislation.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Date
sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Privacy Rights Request Under State Privacy Laws

Dear Privacy Officer or Data Protection Team,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights as a [state] resident under applicable state privacy laws, including but not limited to the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act, Colorado Privacy Act, and other relevant state privacy legislation.

sections.heading: Request Type Selection
sections.content:
I hereby request the following (check all that apply):

☐ Right to Know: Please provide me with information about the personal data you have collected about me, including:
 - Categories of personal data collected
 - Sources of personal data
 - Business purposes for collection
 - Third parties with whom data is shared

☐ Right to Access: Please provide me with a copy of my personal data in a portable format

☐ Right to Delete: Please delete all personal data you have collected about me

☐ Right to Opt-Out: Please opt me out of the sale or sharing of my personal data

☐ Right to Correct: Please correct inaccurate personal data (specify corrections needed below)

sections.heading: Personal Information for Verification
sections.content:
To verify my identity and process this request, I am providing the following information:

Full Name: [Your Name]
Email Address: [Your Email]
Phone Number: [Your Phone Number]
Account Number (if applicable): [Account Number]
Additional Verification Info: [Any other relevant identifiers]

I understand you may need additional information to verify my identity and will cooperate with reasonable verification procedures.

sections.heading: Specific Instructions and Corrections
sections.content:
Additional Details or Corrections Needed:
[Provide specific details about corrections needed or additional instructions for your request]

Preferred Response Method:
☐ Email to: [email address]
☐ Mail to the address above
☐ Secure online portal (if available)

sections.heading: Legal References and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under the authority of applicable state privacy laws, including:
- Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (if applicable)
- Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (if applicable)
- Colorado Privacy Act (if applicable)
- [Other applicable state privacy laws]

I understand that you have up to 45 days to respond to this request, with a possible 45-day extension if needed. Please acknowledge receipt of this request within 10 business days.

sections.heading: Closing and Signature
sections.content:
I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. If you have any questions about this request, please contact me at [your email] or [your phone number].

Thank you for your cooperation in protecting my privacy rights.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
